title: One-time exact Agenda to Form to Schoology setup

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Bounded one-time invocation only: read current scope/authority and existing receipt before creating or repairing; a grading exclusion does not erase requested future setup.
Use installed school-assignment-setup and its native-workflow references for Forms/Schoology; include listed courses in scope without inventing assignments.
Match course/section, lesson component, dates and current source content; preserve separate same-week lessons and approved shared Forms.

Verify Form identity, published/accepting state, intended audience, class selector and required upload question; exact upload View folder, parents/access and actual Hub-reader list/read are separate checks.
Verify saved Schoology page identity, parent/order, body hrefs, published availability and intended student deck access/content; a copy suffix or title is insufficient.
A Form-only repair cannot pass a full chain requiring student material; pending sharing/permission choices remain pending and are not implied by this catalog.
Resume first unverified factor and re-read target before retrying save/create; never submit student work merely to test setup.

success_checks: Expected assignment/component scope reconciles to fresh evidence for identity, Form, upload destination, Hub reader, Schoology page and student material.
Receipt separately counts full setups, partial Form/page repairs, retired exceptions, unassigned slots and exact pending factors.
Existing private checklist contains saved factor evidence; a local gate checker result is not a live verifier.
